## Four oscillators with relative harmonic series offset, invertable attenuation and graphic display ##

boxes.comment: CV1: 1v/oct pitch modulation input. This input is typically used for keyboard tracking since there is no attenuator.
CV2: pitch modulation input. This input has a built-in attenuator (CV2). At 100%, this will track 1v/oct. At 0%, no modulation will occur, even if something is connected to the CV2 input.
